contenders.handicapper_notes: Two-time defending champion of the Grade 2 Green Flash (2024, 2025) and Grade 1 Breeders' Cup Turf Sprint runner-up over this course. Possesses an extraordinary turn of foot over Del Mar 5F turf. Narrowly missed in his prep to Sumter while rallying from off the pace and gets his peak setup here under regular pilot Antonio Fresu and master turf trainer Phil D'Amato. Receives full Horse-for-Course track bonus.

Ultra-consistent 7-year-old gelding from the Richard Mandella barn with elite tactical speed. Defeated Motorious over this 5F layout in the July 19 prep stopping the clock in 55.72. Drawn ideally in post 5 to sit just off the blistering projected pace duel.

Sensational front-running sprinter with 12 wins from 20 lifetime starts. Possesses blazing 20.8 and 21.8 opening fractional speed and lands in barrier 3, perfectly satisfying the track bias upgrade for inside speed drawn in posts 1-5. If he shakes loose early under Edwin Maldonado, he will be very difficult to run down.

Wesley Ward shipper with proven graded stakes turf sprint back-class (Grade 2 Nearctic winner, 4th in this race last year). Juan Hernandez takes the mount and he has worked bullet half-miles at Keeneland preparing for this.
